scientific_scope: A shared-configuration complete-pipeline comparison of H, U, B, and E, with cross-dataset transfer from TechQA development supervision to public four-domain document-grounded Doc2Dial support dialogue.

development_preprocessing.deduplication: Within question, choose a normalized-text representative using fused rank, chunker, chunk ID, document ID, and a label-free row hash; B/E grades are not consulted.
development_preprocessing.pair_filter: Render the complete pinned-tokenizer Qwen training template, including its literal special tokens, with add_special_tokens=false. Prune each pair over 512 independently; retain a group only if its positive and at least one negative survive.

evaluation.selection: All validation documents with at least one eligible user-to-immediately-following-agent transition; exactly one case per eligible document by the already-fixed minimum salted SHA-256 rule.
evaluation.project_exposure: Aggregate metadata and the private selected-case index were inspected in the CPU preflight; no model outcomes exist.
evaluation.sample_and_stopping: Exactly 273 fixed cases; no interim outcome inspection, outcome-based expansion, replacement, optional stopping, or post-outcome exclusion.

dialogue_contract.retrieval_query: Dialogue history through and including the selected user turn, serialized with role prefixes in official-loader order.
dialogue_contract.generation_target: The immediately following agent utterance from the Doc2Dial dialogue data, never the doc2dial_rc grounding-span answer.

reranker.instruction: Given a technical-support question, rank passages by whether they contain sufficient evidence to answer it.

training.loss: For each intact positive-first group, compute final-token yes-minus-no pair scores, apply a temperature-1 softmax within that group, minimize target-index-zero cross entropy, then average group losses. Padding is attention-masked and group boundaries are explicit.
training.matching_rule: B and E receive the same optimizer-update budget at each grid/refit setting. Their label-induced group counts and natural repetitions remain different; no arbitrary duplication or deletion equalizes them.

systems_and_controls.shared_selection: Show all 12 development-grid scores. Choose the single configuration maximizing the mean of B and E question-level validation evidence-NDCG@4; ties choose fewer updates, then lower learning rate. This is shared-configuration pipeline selection, not independent optimization and not isolation of only a label bit.
systems_and_controls.ndcg: DCG@4 uses the returned top four grades; IDCG@4 uses the full common 20-candidate graded pool; zero IDCG returns 0.0.

statistics_frozen_before_outcomes.primary_estimand: Finite-sample document-weighted mean E-minus-B agent-response token-F1 difference across 273 selected documents, after averaging the four chunkers and three paired training seeds within each document.
statistics_frozen_before_outcomes.family_definition: Within each domain, strip a terminal #<digits> suffix from the official document title, normalize surrounding whitespace, and prepend the domain. Cross-domain families are never merged.

bootstrap.statistic: document-weighted mean after sampling intact families within domain

assumptions: Family score vectors are independent across families.
Under the sharp null, signs are exchangeable/symmetric at family level.
The outcome-independent title-family rule captures the material document dependencies.
The fixed sample and missing-output rules are obeyed.
statistics_frozen_before_outcomes.decision_rule: Observed mean >= 0.010 and family-cluster two-sided p < 0.05.
statistics_frozen_before_outcomes.interpretation_warning: This rule is not proof that the population improvement is at least 0.010; that claim would require a lower confidence bound above 0.010 or a prespecified minimum-effect test.
secondary: seed-specific effects, SD, range, and leave-one-seed-out analyses
statistics_frozen_before_outcomes.planning_power: At n=273, the TechQA proxy gives 77.8% power under independence and 70.0% under assumed ICC=0.3 for delta=0.010. These are planning scenarios, not measured properties of Doc2Dial.

job_matrix_requiring_separate_approval.work: B/E x two learning rates x three fixed update budgets
B/E x three paired seeds at the shared selected configuration

post_smoke_budget.basis: Smoke-measured cached load, training token throughput, reranking throughput, and generation throughput, combined with frozen preflight row/token counts. Retrieval remains an old-log extrapolation.
post_smoke_budget.recommended_allocation: 18 A100 GPU-hours; allow a 20-hour operational ceiling for Colab I/O and resumptions, then stop and report rather than expand automatically.
post_smoke_budget.storage: Plan 3-4 GiB of immutable final artifacts excluding model caches, plus 20-25 GiB transient exact-revision model cache. Keep one current resumable checkpoint per active job and an immutable terminal checkpoint; never overwrite a sealed terminal result.
post_smoke_budget.limitations: Training is extrapolated from only two updates with checkpoint-after-every-update; generation is extrapolated from 128 TechQA outputs, not the unknown Doc2Dial response-length distribution. Network model download, multi-hour thermal behavior, Drive stalls, and disconnect frequency are not measured.

runtime_environment.approved_repair_to_freeze: exclude_unused_incompatible_torchao_v1 must remain limited to the unquantized BF16 adapter-construction path and must fail closed if a model is TorchAO-quantized.

pre_execution_gate: Obtain explicit approval for this exact bounded job matrix and Doc2Dial evaluation access.

Create a new content-addressed Phase 4 freeze covering code, configuration, input/index hashes, model revisions, environment, repair identities, seeds, prompts, row counts, statistics, and output namespaces.
Refuse execution if any frozen identity differs or any output namespace is nonempty.
Require complete output for every prescribed cell; retry only technical failures with identical parameters.
Do not inspect outcomes before the fixed matrix completes.

authorization.exact_next_decision: Approve or reject freezing and executing the listed Phase 4 matrix on the fixed 273 Doc2Dial cases with an 18 A100-hour planning allocation and 20-hour operational ceiling.
